description: Bot identity and personality configuration for business owners

name.description: The bot's name that customers will see
name.prompt: What would you like to name your assistant?
name.help: Choose a name that fits your brand. Short names (1-2 syllables) work well.

avatar.prompt: How should your assistant appear visually?

pronouns.prompt: What pronouns should your assistant use?

examples: Hi, I'm Alex! How can I help you today?
Welcome to Acme Support. I'm here to help.
Hey there! Let's get you sorted.
tagline.prompt: How should your assistant greet customers?

professional.label: Professional
professional.example: Thank you for reaching out. I'd be happy to assist you with your inquiry.

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.example: Hey! Great to hear from you. Let me help you out with that.

casual.label: Casual
casual.description: Relaxed, informal, like texting a friend
casual.example: Hey there! What's up? How can I help?

concise.label: Concise
concise.example: Got it. Here's what you need to know:

empathetic.label: Empathetic
empathetic.example: I completely understand how frustrating that must be. Let me help make this right.

tone.description: Fine-tune the personality on a scale
tone.prompt: Adjust the personality sliders to match your brand

voice_examples.description: Example phrases that demonstrate the configured personality

variations.professional: Good afternoon. Thank you for contacting us. How may I assist you today?
variations.friendly: Hi there! Thanks for reaching out. What can I help you with?
variations.casual: Hey! What's going on? How can I help?
variations.empathetic: Hello! I'm glad you reached out. What can I help you with today?

variations.professional: To better assist you, could you please provide additional details regarding your inquiry?
variations.friendly: Sure thing! Could you tell me a bit more so I can help you better?
variations.casual: Got it! Can you give me a few more details?
variations.empathetic: I want to make sure I understand correctly. Could you share a bit more about what's happening?

variations.professional: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me resolve this for you immediately.
variations.friendly: Oh no, I'm really sorry about that! Let me fix this right away.
variations.casual: Ugh, my bad! Let me sort this out for you.
variations.empathetic: I'm so sorry you're dealing with this. That's really frustrating, and I want to help make it right.

variations.professional: I'll connect you with a team member who can provide specialized assistance. Please hold.
variations.friendly: Let me get you connected with someone from our team who can help even better!
variations.casual: Gonna bring in one of our experts for this one. Hang tight!
variations.concise: Transferring you to a specialist now.
variations.empathetic: I want to make sure you get the best help possible, so I'm connecting you with one of our specialists.

variations.professional: Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Thank you for choosing us.
variations.friendly: Anything else I can help with? Thanks so much for chatting!
variations.casual: Need anything else? Great talking to you!
variations.empathetic: Is there anything else on your mind? I'm here if you need me. Take care!

description.help: This helps your assistant understand context when talking to customers

products_services.prompt: What products or services do you offer?
products_services.help: List your main offerings so the assistant knows what you sell

unique_value.help: Your assistant will incorporate this when talking about your business

max_response_length.prompt: How long should typical responses be?

topics_to_avoid.prompt: Topics your assistant should NOT discuss

always_escalate.prompt: Topics that should always go to a human

can_make_promises.prompt: Can your assistant make commitments on your behalf?

after_hours_message.prompt: What should the assistant say outside business hours?
after_hours_message.example: Thanks for reaching out! Our team is currently offline but we'll get back to you first thing tomorrow.

languages.prompt: What languages should your assistant support?

first_conversation.description: What happens when a customer first interacts

examples.prompt: What's the best email to reach you?

examples: Briefly explain what you can help with
